name: Aleph-7
summary: Aleph-7, or ALEPH-7, also known as 4-propylthio-2,5-dimethoxyamphetamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, amphetamine, and DOx families. It is one of the Aleph series of compounds.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, with an EC50 of 2.2 to 7.6 nM and an Emax of 116 to 189%. The drug is also a weak monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), specifically a reversible inhibitor of MAO-A (RIMA), with an IC50 of 2.4 μM.

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Europe in 2005.

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of its family, the DOx amphetamines, tend to be long lasting and can cause anxiety, confusion, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and difficult experiences.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎沒有資料。同家族的 DOx 類安非他命迷幻藥作用時間通常很長，可能引起焦慮、混亂、心跳與血壓上升，以及難受的經驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎没有数据。同家族的 DOx 类安非他命迷幻药作用时间通常很长，可能引起焦虑、混乱、心跳与血压上升，以及难受的经验。

fact.en: Aleph-7 is the amphetamine counterpart of 2C-T-7: both carry the same propylthio group, but Aleph-7 has an extra methyl group next to its amine.
fact.zh: Aleph-7 是 2C-T-7 的安非他命版本：兩者帶有相同的丙硫基，但 Aleph-7 在胺基旁邊多了一個甲基。
fact.zhHans: Aleph-7 是 2C-T-7 的安非他命版本：两者带有相同的丙硫基，但 Aleph-7 在胺基旁边多了一个甲基。
